title: Fastest Internet in Toccoa, GA: TruVista 5 Gig Fiber
description: The fastest internet in Toccoa, GA (30577): TruVista fiber up to 5 Gig, Kinetic fiber up to 2 Gig, Point Broadband, 5G and satellite, from FCC data.
lead: Which networks in Toccoa and Stephens County are really the fastest, how far each reaches, and what to ask before ordering.
short_answer: TruVista lists fiber up to 5 Gig both ways, the fastest speed reported in Toccoa (30577), but its fiber reaches only part of the area. Kinetic by Windstream fiber reaches more homes at up to 2 Gig, and Point Broadband fiber at up to 1 Gig. TruVista's older cable network covers most of town at up to 500 Mbps.

sections.h2: TruVista: fiber in parts of town, cable in the rest
sections.body_html:
TruVista bought the cable systems serving Toccoa and Clayton from Northland Communications in 2012. That older cable network still covers most of Toccoa in the FCC data, at up to 500 Mbps down and 50 Mbps up. Its newer fiber reaches part of the area. TruVista's plan list runs from 250 Mbps to an Ultra 5 Gig tier with equal upload and download, and it says there are no annual contracts. It lists a retail location in Toccoa. Its site does not publish prices; BroadbandNow reports TruVista fiber plans starting at $105 a month, so ask for the price on your street.

If TruVista quotes you service, ask whether your home is on fiber or the older cable network. The difference is mainly upload speed: 50 Mbps on cable versus the same speed both ways on fiber.

Kinetic reports fiber up to 2 Gbps across a large part of 30577, and DSL up to 100 Mbps where fiber has not reached. It has a local office at 166 E Tugalo St. Windstream merged with Uniti in August 2025, and the fiber service keeps the Kinetic name. HighSpeedInternet.com reported Kinetic promotional prices in August 2026 of $39.99 a month for 1 Gig and $59.99 for 2 Gig with autopay; the 1 Gig plan adds a $10.99 monthly gateway fee unless you use your own router, while 2 Gig includes the router. Treat these as reported, not guaranteed.

sections.h2: Is the fastest plan worth it?
sections.body_html:
Very few homes need more than 1 Gbps. A 5 Gig plan helps if several people move very large files or you want headroom for years, but most households will not feel a difference over 500 Mbps to 1 Gig. Run a speed test on your current plan first, and compare the price in month 13, not month 1.

Outside fiber areas in the 30577 ZIP code, Verizon 5G home internet (up to 300 Mbps) reaches most of the area and T-Mobile (up to 100 Mbps) a large part. Starlink is the fastest satellite option.

faq: What is the fastest internet in Toccoa, GA?
TruVista fiber, with plans up to 5 Gig both ways. It reaches only part of the 30577 area, so check your address. Kinetic fiber up to 2 Gig reaches more homes.
Is there fiber internet in Toccoa?

Yes. TruVista, Kinetic by Windstream and Point Broadband all report fiber in the 30577 ZIP code in the June 2026 FCC data: Kinetic across a large part of the area, TruVista and Point Broadband each in part of it.
Does TruVista offer 5 Gig internet in Toccoa?
TruVista lists an Ultra 5 Gig plan and reports 5 Gbps fiber in Toccoa in FCC data, but only part of town is on fiber.
How much is Kinetic internet in Toccoa?

HighSpeedInternet.com reported Kinetic promotional prices of $39.99 a month for 1 Gig and $59.99 for 2 Gig with autopay in August 2026; 1 Gig adds a $10.99 gateway fee unless you use your own router. Confirm the price at your address.
